description: This file defines a class named PaginationRequestHandler that handles pagination logic based on query parameters, providing methods to determine results per page, calculate the offset, and compute total page count.

classes.name: PaginationRequestHandler
classes.description: A class for handling pagination requests, interpreting query parameters to calculate pagination details.

methods.name: GetResultsPerPage
methods.description: Returns the number of results to display per page, defaulting to 20 if not specified.

methods.name: CalculateOffset
methods.description: Calculates the offset for data retrieval based on the current page and results per page.

methods.name: CalculatePageCount
methods.description: Calculates the total number of pages based on total count and results per page.
